=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:1118-1122 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The ledger defaults both an absent `target_repo` and an explicit `null` or `""` to `"consumer"`, although only a missing field should default.
  WHY: If the ownership backstop is unavailable, the field-only fallback accepts a malformed verdict as consumer work and can route a harness change into a consumer fix-up. (Severity "MAJOR" is mapped to high.)
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:572-579 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: In `_harness_route`, `len(tokens) >= HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS` sets `unlisted_project = True` when exactly 50 harness-owned paths were extracted, so the verdict is routed `mixed` instead of `harness`.
  WHY: `_instruction_paths` stops at 50 tokens, so the code cannot tell "exactly 50" from "more were dropped", and `plan()` then keeps the consumer fix-up for a `mixed` route. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna said MAJOR, sonnet said NIT, qwen said NIT. The highest is used.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:587-637 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_report_op` returns `label: ""` when the item has no `HEAL_REPORT_LABELS` label, but `_harness_ops` still writes "A workflow-failure heal report is being sent" and sends only a DEBUG Telegram message.
  WHY: `validate_payload` in scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py (about lines 2059-2064) rejects issue-kind reports whose label is not in `HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS`, so the harness-owned failure is dropped with a false comment and no page. Severity disagreement: sonnet, gemini and luna said MAJOR, qwen said NIT. The highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: When the label is "", say in the comment that no report could be sent because the item has no escalation label and a person must file the harness change, and send the Telegram message at WARNING instead of DEBUG.
  expected_change_site: scripts/unblock_actions.py, _harness_ops
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `_harness_ops` calls `_heal_report_op`, which returns an empty label, and still logs the Telegram message at DEBUG. No logic handles the empty-label case for the comment text or the alert severity.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_ops` with `_heal_report_op` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_heal_report_op` returns `label: ""` when the item has no `HEAL_REPORT_LABELS` label. `_harness_ops` ignores this, still writes "A workflow-failure heal report is being sent", and sends only a DEBUG Telegram message.
  WHY: `validate_payload` rejects an issue-kind report whose label is not in `HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS` (tuple at line 53, rejection at line 2062), so the harness-owned failure is dropped, the comment is false, and nobody is paged.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:`_harness_route`, `if len(tokens) >= HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS: unlisted_project = True` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_instruction_paths` stops at 50 tokens, so a `consumer`-labelled verdict naming exactly 50 harness-owned paths is routed `mixed`, not `harness`.
  WHY: The mixed route keeps the consumer fix-up and adds a heal report, which errs toward keeping the fix-up. Impact is low because a verdict naming 50 or more paths is rare.

- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:1118-1122 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The ledger defaults both an absent `target_repo` and an explicit `null` or `""` to `"consumer"`, although only a missing field should default and invalid values should fail validation.
  WHY: If the ownership backstop is unavailable, the field-only fallback accepts a malformed verdict as consumer work. This can route a harness change into a consumer fix-up.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:572-579; `_instruction_paths` stops at 50 tokens at lines 528-530 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Reaching exactly 50 extracted paths sets `unlisted_project=True`, even when no path was dropped.
  WHY: A consumer-target verdict with exactly 50 harness-owned paths and no project-owned paths is classified as `mixed`, and `plan()` retains the consumer fix-up instead of routing it harness-only.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:591-610, 617-626 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the item has no label accepted by the heal intake, `_heal_report_op()` emits `label: ""`, but `_harness_ops()` still says a report is being sent and queues a DEBUG alert.
  WHY: `validate_payload()` requires a label in `HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS` (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2059-2063`). For an item carrying only `ai:blocked`, no harness report is created while the comment falsely says one is being sent.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:572-579 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When exactly 50 path tokens are extracted and all are harness-owned, the route becomes `mixed` instead of `harness` because `len(tokens) >= HARNESS_MAX_PATH_TOKENS` sets `unlisted_project = True`.
  WHY: `plan()` keeps the consumer fix-up for a mixed route, filing an unnecessary fix-up. The test `test_backstop_token_cap_never_routes_harness_only` does not cover exactly 50 harness paths. The choice is conservative and safe but overly broad.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:_harness_ops 613-637; _heal_report_op 587-610 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the item carries no label in `HEAL_REPORT_LABELS`, `_heal_report_op` returns an empty label, yet `_harness_ops` writes "A workflow-failure heal report is being sent" and sends a DEBUG Telegram.
  WHY: The heal intake rejects issue-kind reports whose label is not in `HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS`, so no report is sent. The comment is false and the DEBUG message pages nobody, so the harness-owned failure is effectively dropped.
